Our digital journey starts here! 
 Create. Grow. Deliver our story to millions. 
 #BTCode, where technology meets creativity. Code is our universal language and innovation is the fuel that propels us into the future. 🚀
 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Java Full Stack Developer to join our development team and contribute to the design, development, and optimization of enterprise-grade applications. The ideal candidate has strong experience with Java technologies, modern frontend frameworks, security standards, and database optimization, while being comfortable working across the full software development lifecycle.
 If you’ll join our team, you will be challenged to: 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using Java and Spring technologies.
Build and enhance RESTful and SOAP-based services and integrations.
Develop responsive user interfaces using Angular, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Implement secure authentication and authorization solutions using Spring Security, SSO, LDAP, and Active Directory.
Design and optimize database structures, queries, and transactions within Oracle environments.
Ensure application security through SSL/TLS, certificate-based authentication, and encryption mechanisms.
Implement caching strategies to improve application performance and scalability.
Apply software design patterns and best practices to deliver maintainable and high-quality code.
Develop unit and integration tests using JUnit.
Troubleshoot and resolve application performance bottlenecks.
Collaborate with architects, business analysts, and development teams to define and implement technical solutions.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
 To perform in this role, we would like you to have: 
Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot development.
 Strong knowledge of Angular , HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (Experience with React is considered a plus) .
Good understanding of REST/SOAP services and integration patterns.
Experience working with Oracle databases and database performance optimization (Knowledge of T-SQL and advanced querying techniques is an advantage) .
Solid knowledge of Spring Security, SSO, LDAP, and Active Directory .
Understanding of SSL/TLS, certificate-based authentication, and encryption mechanisms .
Experience with Hibernate, JPA, transaction management, and caching strategies .
Knowledge of software design patterns and testing frameworks such as JUnit .
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Nice to Have 
Experience in large enterprise environments.
Experience in banking or financial services.
Familiarity with microservices architecture.
 Ready to venture into this technological journey?
